value.rationale: The prime-permitted zero-gap shift is explicitly singled out in prior work as a canonical sparse arithmetic symbolic system. The exact rare-marker entropy deficit t log log(1/t), its Euler constant and pi-squared correction quantify the cost of arithmetic constraints in a natural statistical invariant rather than recomputing topological entropy. These are nontrivial arithmetic asymptotics requiring PNT-level estimates, with an infinite set of gaps and no arbitrary numeric cutoff. The quantitative coefficients and justified remainder go substantially beyond the routine implicit renewal formula.
